notes.title: 1.1c Patch + Thanks for getting the game and for the nice reviews!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863474/1f9cc3da1ece49af2fcee1d0d3999162453343ac.png[/img]

Hey all!!

[b]Thank you so much for getting MOONPONG!![/b] We just updated the game with some minor fixes, here they are:
[list]
[*] Accessibility settings "reset to defaults" now also resets shop exit pause duration
[*] Fixed initial slider position for game speed in settings
[*] Fixed button text for mouse cursor hat
[*] No longer ignoring master volume while fading out the music on quitting the game
[*] Game speed is correctly re-set after boss deaths
[/list]
Thanks to the players who reported bugs, and sorry we were so slow to fix them! We've been quite busy but we're happy to finally make it right!

A few of you have left reviews on the game, and they're all positive, thank you so much for that!! In fact, [i][b]we're only missing one review to get a rating on the Steam page![/b][/i] So, er, have you written a review for the game yet?? Reviews really help games find their audience on here, so even a one-sentence review saying that you enjoyed the game would be a tremendous help!

Anyway, we're thinking about updating the game with new items for new PUNKCAKE releases, so this shouldn't be the last Steam news for this game!

On a different note, MOONPONG and our other game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972440/Shotgun_King_The_Final_Checkmate/][b]Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate[/b][/url] are 25% off for the next 7 days, starting right now! And buying them as part of the PUNKCAKE Délicieux Developer Bundle gives you a further 15% discount! It's a pretty neat deal if you don't already own both of them!

[b]Have a very nice weekend, and may the Moon stay withing the Earth's orbit for some more time![/b]
- [i]PUNKCAKE Délicieux[/i] 🥞
